# Parser Boundary Check Vulnerability Report

## Description
The `parse_index` function in `parser/bounds.py` lacks explicit bounds checking before accessing the list elements. This allows an `IndexError` to be triggered when an out-of-bounds index is provided.

## Evidence of Trigger
Execution of the reproduction script confirmed that providing an index of `REDACTED_TRIGGER` results in a successful boundary violation (IndexError).

## Source Code Reference
```python
def parse_index(items, index):
    return items[index]
```
